privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
# PRISM Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 2026

PRISM (“PRISM,” “the System,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is a web-based system for IERB progress monitoring, research document management, notifications, and reporting. PRISM is operated by Research Progress Monitoring Section for authorized users associated with Centro Escolar University - Malolos

This Privacy Policy explains the information PRISM collects, why it is used, how it is protected, and how Google user data is handled.

## 1. Information PRISM Processes

PRISM may process information necessary to operate institutional research-management workflows, including:

- name and institutional account information;
- institutional email address;
- Student ID or Employee ID;
- academic unit, program/course, year level, and academic year where applicable;
- Research/Capstone Adviser assignment and research-group information;
- protocol codes and IERB progress information;
- uploaded research and IERB-related documents;
- document review decisions, remarks, versions, and submission history;
- notifications and workflow communications;
- account, security, activity, and audit records; and
- reports generated from authorized PRISM records.

PRISM processes this information only for legitimate system, academic, research-administration, security, reporting, and institutional purposes.

## 2. Gmail API and Google User Data

PRISM uses the Google Gmail API solely to send PRISM-generated email through a designated institutional or system Gmail/Google Workspace sender account.

PRISM requests only:

https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send

This permission allows PRISM to send email from the authorized sender account.

PRISM does not use the Gmail API to read, search, retrieve, modify, organize, or delete the sender's existing email messages, inbox contents, contacts, or other Gmail data.

PRISM uses Gmail authorization only for sending legitimate system communications such as account-related messages, password-reset communications, submission and review notifications, deadlines, follow-ups, and other authorized PRISM workflow messages.

Google OAuth credentials and refresh tokens are stored in protected server-side configuration and are not made available to ordinary PRISM users.

PRISM does not sell Google user data, use Google user data for advertising, or use Gmail API data to train general-purpose or personalized artificial-intelligence models.

PRISM's use of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

## 3. How Information Is Used

PRISM uses information to:

- authenticate and manage authorized accounts;
- manage Student, Adviser, and RPMS workflows;
- process and track research and IERB documents;
- provide document-review and progress-monitoring features;
- send authorized notifications and communications;
- generate institutional research-management reports;
- maintain security and audit records;
- investigate errors, abuse, or unauthorized access; and
- maintain the availability and integrity of the System.

PRISM does not use personal information for unrelated advertising or commercial profiling.

## 4. AI-Assisted Reporting

PRISM may provide AI-assisted aggregate reporting features for authorized RPMS personnel.

Where external AI services are used, PRISM is designed to limit the data transmitted to what is required for the authorized reporting function and to apply applicable privacy protections.

Google Gmail API data and OAuth credentials are not provided to PRISM's AI service providers and are not used for AI model training.

AI-generated reports are intended to assist authorized users and should be reviewed by a human before being relied upon for official decisions.

## 5. Information Sharing

PRISM information may be accessible to authorized users according to their assigned role and legitimate institutional responsibilities.

PRISM does not sell personal information.

Information may be disclosed where necessary:

- to provide PRISM's authorized functions;
- to infrastructure or service providers acting on behalf of the operator;
- to comply with applicable law, legal process, or institutional obligations;
- to protect the security and integrity of PRISM and its users; or
- with appropriate authorization or consent.

Access is subject to PRISM's role-based authorization controls.

## 6. Data Retention

Information is retained only for as long as necessary for legitimate institutional, academic, research-management, audit, security, and legal purposes.

PRISM supports account archiving and controlled account deletion. Some records may need to be retained longer where an account is subject to a retention hold, unresolved workflow, audit requirement, legal obligation, or other legitimate institutional requirement.

Deletion of an account does not necessarily require deletion of records that must lawfully or institutionally be preserved independently.

## 7. Security

PRISM uses technical and organizational safeguards intended to protect information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction.

These safeguards include role-based access controls, authentication, authorization checks, session protections, protected server storage, audit records, and controlled access to sensitive configuration such as OAuth credentials.

No internet-connected system can guarantee absolute security.

## 8. User Responsibilities

Users must protect their account credentials and must not share passwords, authentication links, reset links, or other security credentials.

Users should immediately report suspected unauthorized access to [SUPPORT/PRIVACY EMAIL].

## 9. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law and institutional policy, users may have rights concerning their personal information, including rights to request access, correction, or deletion, object to certain processing, or raise privacy concerns.

Some requests may be limited by legitimate academic, institutional, research, audit, security, or legal retention requirements.

Requests may be sent to:

[PRIVACY CONTACT / DATA PROTECTION OFFICER]

Email: [EMAIL ADDRESS]

Institution/Organization: [NAME]

Where applicable, data subjects may also exercise rights provided under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 and related regulations.

## 10. Third-Party Services

PRISM may rely on third-party services necessary to provide particular functionality, including Google APIs for email delivery and authorized hosting or AI services.

Use of those services is subject to their respective terms and privacy requirements in addition to PRISM's controls.

## 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated when PRISM's functionality, data practices, applicable requirements, or third-party integrations change.

The current version will be published at:

[PUBLIC PRIVACY POLICY URL]

Material changes will be communicated where appropriate.

## 12. Contact

For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or PRISM's handling of personal information, contact:

[ORGANIZATION / PRISM OPERATOR]

Email: [SUPPORT/PRIVACY EMAIL]

Address: Km. 44 McArthur Highway, Barangay Longos, City of Malolos, Bulacan, 3000 Philippines

terms.content:
# PRISM Terms of Service

Effective Date: October 2026

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern access to and use of PRISM, a web-based system for research document management, IERB progress monitoring, notifications, and reporting operated by the Research Progress Monitoring Section

By accessing PRISM, you agree to use the System only for authorized academic, research, administrative, and institutional purposes.

## 1. Authorized Users

PRISM is intended only for authorized users, which may include Students, Research/Capstone Advisers, and authorized RPMS personnel.

Access rights depend on the user's assigned role.

You may not access another person's account or attempt to obtain functionality for which your account is not authorized.

## 2. Account Security

Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials.

Users must not:

- share passwords or account credentials;
- impersonate another person;
- attempt to bypass authentication or authorization;
- access records outside their authorized scope; or
- interfere with PRISM's security controls.

Suspected unauthorized access should be reported immediately to [SUPPORT EMAIL].

## 3. Acceptable Use

PRISM may be used only for legitimate research, academic, IERB, administrative, and related institutional activities.

Users must not use PRISM to:

- upload unlawful, malicious, or unauthorized content;
- distribute malware;
- attempt to compromise the System;
- interfere with another user's access;
- circumvent role or document restrictions;
- send unauthorized or abusive communications; or
- use system information for an unrelated purpose.

## 4. Research Documents and Records

Users are responsible for ensuring that materials they upload are appropriate and authorized for institutional processing.

Uploading a document to PRISM does not by itself constitute approval by an Adviser, RPMS, an ethics review body, or any other institutional authority.

Official status depends on the workflow and decisions recorded by authorized reviewers.

## 5. Email Communications

PRISM may send account, security, research-workflow, document-review, deadline, and other authorized institutional email communications.

PRISM uses the Gmail API with authorization from the designated PRISM sender account for this purpose.

Users acknowledge that operational communications may be necessary for use of the System.

## 6. AI-Assisted Features

PRISM may provide AI-assisted reporting or analysis to authorized users.

AI-generated material is assistive and may contain errors or incomplete interpretations. Authorized users remain responsible for reviewing AI-assisted outputs before using them for official institutional or research decisions.

PRISM's Gmail API authorization and Gmail data are not used to train AI models.

## 7. Availability

PRISM may occasionally be unavailable due to maintenance, technical failures, hosting interruptions, security incidents, third-party service outages, or other circumstances.

Continuous or error-free operation is not guaranteed.

## 8. Third-Party Services

PRISM may depend on third-party services including hosting infrastructure, Google APIs, and authorized AI or reporting services.

Those services may be governed by separate terms and policies.

## 9. Privacy

Use of PRISM is also governed by the PRISM Privacy Policy:

[PUBLIC PRIVACY POLICY URL]

## 10. Account Suspension, Archiving, and Termination

Accounts may be restricted, archived, suspended, or terminated where required by institutional policy, security requirements, account lifecycle rules, authorized administrative action, or misuse of the System.

Account removal may be subject to retention requirements and other safeguards.

## 11. Intellectual Property

PRISM software, branding, interface materials, and system-generated materials are subject to the rights of their respective owners.

Users retain rights they lawfully hold in materials they submit, subject to the institutional rights necessary to process those materials for authorized research and administrative purposes.

## 12. Disclaimer

PRISM assists with research-management and IERB-related processes but does not independently grant ethics approval, academic approval, regulatory approval, or legal authorization.

System information should be interpreted together with applicable institutional policies and decisions from authorized personnel.

## 13. Limitation of Liability

To the extent permitted by applicable law, [ORGANIZATION / OPERATOR] is not responsible for losses resulting from unauthorized use, user error, circumstances outside reasonable operational control, or reliance on unofficial or unreviewed system output.

Nothing in these Terms excludes obligations that cannot lawfully be excluded.

## 14. Changes to These Terms

These Terms may be updated as PRISM develops or institutional and legal requirements change.

The current Terms will be published at:

[PUBLIC TERMS URL]

Continued authorized use after an update may be subject to the revised Terms, consistent with applicable requirements.

## 15. Governing Requirements

Use of PRISM remains subject to applicable Philippine law and relevant institutional policies, rules, and research requirements.

## 16. Contact

Questions about these Terms may be sent to:

[ORGANIZATION / PRISM OPERATOR]

Email: [SUPPORT EMAIL]

Address: Km. 44 McArthur Highway, Barangay Longos, City of Malolos, Bulacan, 3000 Philippines
